title: kg_contrib.added_hits calls shipped_file_hits without the file's root, so a placeholder a public root lists passes publish but is left out by contribute as a leak-scan hit
goal: kg_contrib.added_hits passes each file's root (kbpublic.root_of with the root placeholders of HEAD) to shipped_file_hits as publish's tree scan does
repro_reason: needs a public root whose _root.md lists a placeholder and a contribute upstream; the planted input is in the notes
notes: SP-mut2pmu3 review gap 9 (S3, outside the sprint's commits). kg_contrib.py:98 (added_hits) calls shipped_file_hits(x, added, allow, pinned) with no root, so the placeholders a public root lists never pass in contribute, while publish (tree_hits, leak_verdicts via root_of) lets them pass: a commit that adds a listed placeholder home path to a public root is left out by contribute as a hit (home) and would publish. Fails closed. This is the S4 half BG-ff6fhfoo left out. Fix: pass root_of(x, kbpublic.root_placeholders(head, files, KB)).
